title: Replace useAppStore() over-subscription in Sidebar and EvaluationPanel
action: Replace bare useAppStore() destructuring with targeted selectors in Sidebar.tsx and EvaluationPanel.tsx
implementation:
1. src/components/Sidebar.tsx:42 — replace `const { createConversation, selectConversation } = useAppStore()` with `const createConversation = useCreateConversation(); const selectConversation = useSelectConversation();` and import both from selectors
2. src/components/EvaluationPanel.tsx:540 — replace `const { addMessage } = useAppStore()` with `const addMessage = useAddMessage();` and import from selectors
